passage:
Woman: We need to move the long display case from the van to the upstairs showroom. Both lifts can carry it, but the public lift is the only step-free route for visitors. We need to leave it free from ten onward.
Man: The freight lift is booked until ten thirty. We need the lift and both movers for the full twenty minutes. One of them leaves at eleven.
Man: We could take the case into the office now and send it upstairs later.
Woman: Let's not give the case a guided tour. Once it leaves the van, someone has to check the seals at every handover. The driver can wait here until we take it upstairs.
Man: One more thing. At eleven, the booking screen will mark the room available. The setup team can plug the display in as soon as it is in place, but Facilities won't inspect the finished setup until eleven thirty.
Woman: The screen only shows whether someone booked the room. Before opening the doors, the welcome desk needs confirmation that the room is safe for visitors. With a powered display, only Facilities can issue that clearance.

questions.prompt: Which proposed move fits the lift and staffing arrangements?

choices.A: Start using the public lift at ten oh five.
choices.B: Start using the freight lift at ten thirty-five.
choices.C: Start using the freight lift at ten fifty.
choices.D: Start using the freight lift at ten ten.

questions.prompt: What does the woman mean when she says, “Let's not give the case a guided tour”?

choices.A: She thinks a worker should guide visitors while the case is being moved.
choices.B: She wants to move the case out of the van promptly so the driver does not have to wait.
choices.C: She prefers leaving the case in the office until someone can replace its seals.
choices.D: She wants to avoid a stop in the office that would add another handover.

questions.prompt: Suppose the display is already running when the room appears as available at eleven. How should the welcome desk respond?

choices.A: Admit visitors as soon as the booking screen changes.
choices.B: Keep visitors outside until Facilities approves the setup.
choices.C: Admit visitors at eleven thirty even if Facilities has not cleared the setup.
choices.D: Keep visitors outside until the setup team plugs in the display again.
